material_class.structural_family: Polyoxotungstate; discrete three-shell, cage-shaped nonanuclear Nd-oxo cluster

source_locations.location: Introduction; CCDC deposition 2391930 cited for compound 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A central planar nitrate anion is hosted in a cage-shaped nonanuclear Nd-oxo cluster. The assembly comprises one Nd9 oxo/hydroxo cluster capped by a disordered XO4 tetrahedron and is surrounded by one trilacunary {A-α-SiW9O34} and three dilacunary {A-α-SiW10O37} polyoxotungstate units, forming an approximate C-symmetric three-shell structure.

synthesis.ph: 10, adjusted dropwise with sodium hydroxide solution
synthesis.procedure: Mix the four reported starting materials in 4 mL deionized water. Adjust to pH 10 with sodium hydroxide solution and stir for 1.5 h. Seal in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heat at 140 °C for 120 h. Cool to room temperature, then allow the filtrate to evaporate slowly at room temperature for one week.
synthesis.temperature: 140 °C for autoclave reaction; room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.time: 1.5 h stirring; 120 h heating; one week evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, the filtrate was slowly evaporated at room temperature for one week to obtain purple rectangular block crystals.

source_locations.location: Introduction; CCDC deposition 2391931 cited for compound 2
Structural discussion, Figure 2, and Figures S6–S8 referenced in main text

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Each Nd9-containing POT unit is analogous to that in 1, except that its disordered XO4 tetrahedron is replaced by an ordered sulfate unit. The units are connected through Zn(H2O)4 bridges into a two-dimensional honeycomb framework; tetrahedral Zn aqua complexes occupy the large hexagonal cavities, while layers stack with additional octahedral Zn(H2O)6 complexes and dimethylammonium cations in the interlayer spaces.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained as new crystals by evaporating a solution of compound 1 with ZnSO4 added for ten days; no reagent amount or concentration for this crystal preparation is reported in the main-text passage.

reagents.name: zinc sulfate
reagents.role: reactant added to a solution of compound 1

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals of compound 2 obtained by evaporation.

title: Polyoxotungstate Featuring Zinc-Ion-Triggered Structural Transformation as An Efficient Electrolyte Additive for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
